construct_optimizer_sgd: construct an SGD optimizer with momentum and weight decay for a PyTorch model using OptimizerConf
construct_optimizer_adamw: construct an AdamW optimizer with configurable learning rate and weight decay for a PyTorch model
construct_optimizer_lars: construct an optimizer wrapped with LARS adaptive rate scaling for large batch training
configure_optimizer_conf: configure an OptimizerConf dataclass with method, learning rate, momentum, and weight decay settings
lars_step: perform a LARS optimizer step that adaptively scales learning rates per parameter group
